subject: Markdown to Word via pandoc printing a linear regression summary table

messages.author: 0beedbaa451f0901
messages.subject: Markdown to Word via pandoc printing a linear regression summary table
parts:
Hello!

I'm try to put together a little "show and tell" for regression for some people.  However, the output must be in Word.  Don't ask, please.

Anyhow, I'm using knitr to produce a nice Markdown file.  Then I'm using pandoc to transfer over to Word.  But the summary output from the linear regression does not appear.

I will attach what I have (hope that's ok) and any suggestions would be much appreciated.  I've tried all kinds of things.

Thanks,
Erin

messages.author: 8502567f9dbc7c7e
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Markdown to Word via pandoc printing a linear regression summary table
parts: You have neither the {r} syntax to signal knitr that this is executable nor the result='as.is' chunk option to tell knitr to pass through the output from the xtable object into the knitr output for handling downstream. Unfortunately, you don't seem to be including latex or html in your tool chain, so xtable is unlikely to work for you either. The knitr "kable" function might help.

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Markdown to Word via pandoc printing a linear regression summary table
parts: Look at the pander package, it has tools for producing markdown syntax from many standard R outputs.  It can be used with knitr (and the type asis) or it can also feed directly to markdown documents and convert them to word.  I have used it with and without knitr for clients who insist on having the results in Word (some insist on Word output even after my attempted jokes about Word as a word processor treating the output like a food processor treats food).
